evals.name: bakery-greenfield-gate
evals.prompt: Build a landing page for my bakery, Pan de Sal Co. in Quezon City. Hero, menu with prices, newsletter signup, and a contact form. Use Next.js.
evals.expected_output: Plan written with requirement matrix covering all 3 rulebooks, owners, done-when checks, N-A for Supabase/Stripe items with reasons; run stops for user approval with no app code written.

evals.name: kwento-nextjs-supabase-harden
evals.prompt: My Next.js + Supabase comments app Kwento is in this folder. Make it production ready before launch.
evals.expected_output: Turn 1 stops at plan approval without touching source. Turn 2: service_role removed from client, RLS + WITH CHECK policies migration, DOMPurify or text rendering for comments, security headers/CSP, no localStorage tokens, Zod validation, SEO basics, one h1, alt text, 44px targets, delete-all confirmation, QC report verifying each ID.

evals.name: lakbay-express-static-harden
evals.prompt: Here's my travel photo site Lakbay: plain HTML plus a small Express server with a guestbook and contact form. Harden it and make it launch-ready. Keep it plain HTML/Express, don't switch frameworks.
evals.expected_output: Plan adapts Next/Supabase rules to Express (Supabase N-A). Turn 2: guestbook XSS fixed, security headers, rate limiting, server-side validation, body size limit, no stack traces or PII in logs, meta/OG/canonical, robots + sitemap, one h1, alt text, 404 page, tap targets and contrast fixed, still plain HTML/Express, QC report.
